ayahOccurrences.text: أَفِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ أَمِ ٱرْتَابُوٓا۟ أَمْ يَخَافُونَ أَن يَحِيفَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَرَسُولُهُۥ ۚ بَلْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: أَفِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ أَمِ ٱرْتَابُوٓا۟ أَمْ يَخَافُونَ أَن يَحِيفَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَرَسُولُهُۥ ۚ بَلْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 3rd person masculine singular imperfect verb, subjunctive mood
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: يَحِيفَ is in the derivative form: يَحِيفُ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ح/ي/ف ḥ–y–f deviation, to veer away; to be unjust, to wrong; to curtail, to impair. Of this root, يَحِيفُ yaḥıf occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
يَحِيفُ yaḥıf [imperf. of v. حَافَ ḥāfa, intrans. with prep. على] to make incursions into, to deal unjustly with, to lean heavily on

(24:50) أَمْ يَخَافُونَ أَنْ يَحِيفَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ ورسوله or do they fear that God and His Messenger might deal with them unjustly?
